review:
A luxury cruise on 25 lines with a ship-captain wild and scatter tickets. Three tickets open one of two free spins events, and they play very differently.

Big Catch fills reels 2 to 4 with the same symbol for five spins, while the VIP Only party gives eight spins with only mid and high symbols. On top of that there's a Hold and Win with three jackpots, triggered by filling a 3x3 grid. Medium-high volatility, 2,000x max, bonus about once every 209 spins. RTP is lower at 94.98%.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
